notes.title: The Full Paralives Development Roadmap + April Dev Update
notes.content:
📢 We are very excited to share the full development roadmap up until the release! We hope this gives you a better idea of all the work that goes into the game and what you can expect from Paralives. ✨

[h3]The roadmap link:[/h3]
➡️➡️➡️ paralives.notion.site/f138c4f6cb234604be16fe4198d17f51

On the roadmap, you might notice that there will be an Early Access for the game. We still have some way to go before the release and we are not ready to announce a release date or an estimated price yet but keep an eye out for more news and game development updates! Everyone will be able to play the game in Early Access through Steam, no need to register anywhere.

Aside from this new roadmap, here is last month's recap.

[h2]April Dev Update[/h2]
Here’s what the Paralives team has been working on for the past month.
🎨 Worked on the art style of the environments (furniture, walls, floors, grass, and vegetation)
🎨 Improved some sliders in the Paramaker such as the fat and muscles sliders
🎨 Improved the eye color options
🛠️ Implemented a clothing layering system in the Paramaker
🛠️ Added functionality for clothes to be tucked in or out of bottom clothes
🛠️ Created new live mode animations
🛠️ Worked on the design of the animation system including object interaction
🛠️ Added systems to execute character interactions and animations in sequence
🛠️ Created the interaction queue interface to plan the actions of your characters
🛠️ Worked on randomization for the Paramaker
🛠️ Started testing the pathfinding for the live mode
🛠️ Fixed bugs and improved various features of the Paramaker
🎶 Made demos to explore the musical style of the game
🎶 Improved sounds for the Paramaker
🧠 Fifteenth public community brainstorming on basic and complex needs
✨ Secrets!

[b]Current Status - May 2022[/b]
➡️ Brainstorming and designing the live mode core systems: interactions, animations, pathfinding
➡️ Improving the Paramaker, adding more features and fixing bugs
➡️ Adding body and face shapes for the adult human model
➡️ Designing and implementing the animation system and its mod support
➡️ Creating more character animations
➡️ Working on the musical direction and soundtrack of the game
➡️ Brainstorming and designing different aspects of the game

notes.title: Tattoo Feature Improved!
notes.content:
We’ve recently improved the tattoo feature of the Paramaker. In the [url=https://youtu.be/saPMQS1jquc?t=70]Paramaker video[/url] we showcased last December, we showed you how to place, rotate, and resize tattoos on a Parafolk’s arm. 

We brought the feature one step further:
[list]
[*] Flip your tattoo vertically or horizontally
[*] Choose the body sections where you wish to place one or more tattoos
[*] Select the exact color scheme you want or get the elegant black and gray variant
[/list]

Check it out in action in the video below!
[previewyoutube=MqY250WZ8NI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: March Dev Update + Community Brainstorming: Needs
notes.content:
[h2]March 2022 Dev Update[/h2]

Hey everyone! 
Hope you’ve been doing well. Here’s what the Paralives team has been working on for the past month. 
📅 Planned features to integrate to the interaction menu
🎨 Worked on the art style of the environments (furniture, walls, floors, and vegetation)
🎨 Added chin customization options
🎨 Added and improved some sliders in the Paramaker
🎨 Improved textures on the Parafolks
🛠️ Added new emotion animations
🛠️ Brainstormed new animation ideas for the live mode
🛠️ Worked on the design of the interaction, action and animation systems
🛠️ Made various improvements to our modding tools and the control panel
🛠️ Fixed bugs and improved various features of the Paramaker such as the tool for tattoos
🎶 Made demos to explore the musical style of the game
🎶 Created and improved sounds for the Paramaker
🧠 Fourteenth public [url=https://twitter.com/ParalivesGame/status/1501226563966230531?s=20&t=HeJMlm0Wz75TGxqOG2Enxg]community brainstorming on town services and businesses[/url]
🏡 Shared a [url=https://twitter.com/ParalivesGame/status/1507009342247256064?s=20&t=HeJMlm0Wz75TGxqOG2Enxg]sketch of a house[/url] we are currently working on
💫 Showcased a [url=https://twitter.com/ParalivesGame/status/1504473113571966982?s=20&t=HeJMlm0Wz75TGxqOG2Enxg]dizzy Maggie[/url] in the Paramaker
✨ Secrets!

[b]Current Status - April 2022[/b]
➡️ Brainstorming and designing the live mode core systems: interactions, animations, pathfinding
➡️ Improving the Paramaker, adding more features and fixing bugs
➡️ Adding body and face shapes for the adult human model
➡️ Designing and implementing the animation system and its mod support
➡️ Creating more character animations
➡️ Working on the musical direction and soundtrack of the game
➡️ Brainstorming and designing different aspects of the game

You can also find the full development progress on [url=https://www.paralives.com/development#2022]our website[/url].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095985/30be1cae458b181ba612be0911993d92611b9522.png[/img]

[h2]Community Brainstorming Session[/h2]

Here we go again with a Paralives community brainstorming! 🧠
The new theme is: [b]Basic and Complex Needs[/b]!

Here are some questions that you can ask yourself:
🔋 What needs would you like to see in Paralives?
⚖️ How would you prioritize or categorize needs? 
😐 How would ignoring a need for too long impact Parafolks?
🍽️ What would be different ways to fulfill each need?
👪 Should all Parafolk have the same needs? Should it vary from one Parafolk to another?

💡 To participate, share your ideas on our [url=https://discord.gg/paralives]Discord server[/url] in the #basic-and-complex-needs channel or on [url=https://bit.ly/ParalivesApr2022Brainstorm]Reddit[/url]!

Cheers!
The Paralives Team

notes.title: February Dev Update + Community Brainstorming: Town Services
notes.content:
[h2]February 2022 Dev Update[/h2]

Hey everyone! 
Hope you’ve been doing well. 
We usually post a list of development updates on our [url=https://www.paralives.com/development#2022]website[/url], but last month we decided to start sharing it directly on Steam every month as well. So without further ado, here’s what we’ve been working on for the month of February 2022.

📅 Worked on the planning of some live mode features
🎨 Improved the art style of the environments
🎨 Worked on the art style for vegetation
🎨 Added some textures on the Parafolks
🎨 Improved skin textures and Paramaker sliders
🛠️ Worked on the design of some live mode features such as the action system
🛠️ Started working on the live mode interaction menu
🛠️ Tested the system that makes the clothes fit with any body shape and size
🛠️ Fixed bugs and improved the Paramaker
🎶 Made demos to explore the musical style of the game
🧠 Thirteenth public community brainstorming on emotions and mood
✏️ Shared a [url=https://twitter.com/ParalivesGame/status/1496877868999221249?s=20&t=Yp8vGw8GFu_KBWTzc8tPew]sketch of Sebasitan’s outfit[/url]
🍇 Introduced “helpers”, a new role in our Discord server to help answer community questions
✨ Secrets!

[b]Current Status - March 2022[/b]
➡️ Brainstorming and designing the live mode core systems: interactions, animations, pathfinding
➡️ Improving the Paramaker, adding more features and fixing bugs
➡️ Adding body and face shapes for the adult human model
➡️ Designing and implementing the animation system and its mod support
➡️ Creating more character animations
➡️ Working on the musical direction and soundtrack of the game
➡️ Brainstorming and designing different aspects of the game


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095985/2cd336858e1fd4a0c81808a6810df7cca934b12f.png[/img]

[h2]Community Brainstorming Session[/h2]

Here we go again with a new Paralives community brainstorming! 🧠
The new theme is: [b]Town Services & Businesses[/b]!

Here are some questions that you can ask yourself:
🛒 What town services and businesses would you like to see in-game?
🚒 Which services could be offered by Parafolks or NPCs (e.g. mail carrier) and which ones could be lot services (e.g. town hall, library, etc.)?
🍁 What kind of town services and businesses could be specific to one town or season?
🏡 Which services could be offered at home and which ones would you need to go out to get?
🚗 Which businesses would you need to call or visit to obtain what they offer? For example, would you need to go to a tattoo parlor to add a tattoo to your Parafolk or should it only be done in the Paramaker? Would you need to order or shop for food or should it always be available in your kitchen?

💡 To participate, share your ideas on [url=https://discord.gg/paralives]our Discord server[/url] in the #town-services-and-businesses channel or on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Paralives/comments/t8wye8/community_brainstorming_session_town_services/]Reddit[/url]!

That’s all for now. See you around!
The Paralives Team

notes.title: January Dev Update + Sneak Peek at Spin Animation
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Haven’t posted an update in a little while. We, the dev team, want to be as transparent as we can concerning the development process. We usually post a list of development updates on our [url=https://www.paralives.com/development]website[/url] but we were thinking it would be interesting to share it directly on Steam too from now on. 

So without further ado, here’s what we’ve been working on for the month of January 2022:

notes.title: 📢 Video Update: Skin color wheel, tattoo placement and more!
notes.content:
'Tis the season of giving dev updates! 🎁⛄️

Didn’t we tell you we’d be back soon with a crunchy dev update? Today’s the day! 
We are happy to unveil different ways to customize your characters in Paralives using the in-game character creation tool called the Paramaker. We really wanted to offer an extra level of customization with [b]freehand tattoo placement and scaling, heterochromia, 2 color wheels for skin tones[/b]… We are also introducing new characters (townies)!
We’ll stop talking and let you enjoy the video instead! ;)

[previewyoutube=saPMQS1jquc;full][/previewyoutube]

Please let us know in the comment section what you think and what feature you are most looking forward to using in the Paramaker! We do read those even if we don’t reply very often.

This is our last dev update of the year so we would like to take this opportunity to wish you happy holidays! May the new year bring you a new favourite game, whichever it may be!

Cheers,
The Paralives Team

notes.title: Sneak peek at the new sliders & character editing in Paralives
notes.content:
[h3]Slide, slide, slide! Discover how to freely reshape your Parafolk! 🎨🌟[/h3]

[previewyoutube=wKhAb42Gmx4;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
With this new feature, you can use our handy diagrams to quickly customize the shape, size and rotation of different parts of your Parafolk. You can edit a wide variety of sliders for important body and facial features and tweak the smallest little details. For those who like to fine tune, the sliders are also displayed in a more traditional fashion below the diagram where you can enter exact numbers and even copy-paste them between Parafolks. 

Learn why we went for this new diagram tool for our Paramaker in [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/59633437]this public Patreon post[/url]. 

Talk to you soon!
The Paralives Team
